segments.Management Opening Statement: Ladies and gentlemen, it was a challenging quarter impacted by macroeconomic headwinds and supply chain issues.
segments.Financial Highlights: Revenue declined by 4% year-over-year. Margins contracted due to input cost inflation.
segments.Outlook & Guidance: Given the near-term uncertainty, we are cautious and lowering our outlook for the second half.
segments.Q&A Session: Analyst: When do you see recovery? Mgmt: We expect pressure to continue for at least two more quarters.
